Hi to ramp team,
Slow stint so far, and a visiting trainer flagged a question about training days. I am sending a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways so the record stays clear and the handoff stays smooth. The welfare coordinator has been keeping an eye on comfort checks, while the passenger coordinator has been steady with the travel steps and reminders. We can keep the tone simple and calm for any traveler who needs extra help at check-in or at pickup.

One item came up in the thread for a cat case, and the guidance below should be treated as the current reference. <<FACT F067>> Please keep that note visible in the service file and avoid adding extra detail in replies, since the brief version helps everyone stay aligned. If a traveler brings in a crate, the team should still check that the fit, ventilation, and latch all match the usual care standard before the animal moves onward.

Another item came up for a small dog case, and the same approach applies when you are updating the file. <<FACT F074>> After that, the notes should reflect only the standard travel steps, any comfort concerns, and whether the handoff was calm and smooth. If there is anything unusual about the pet's behavior, please pass it to the welfare coordinator so it can be reviewed with care.

Thanks for keeping the updates tidy and patient. Clear notes help Aurelia Skyways support travelers and their companion animals with less friction and better follow-through.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
